entries.title: scout — test any MCP server, from your own machine
entries.content:
Skip to main content S scout Menu System Running locally · nothing leaves this machineTest an MCP server.Nine phases, 76 checks, both protocol generations. Every finding is tied to the request that produced it, and the whole run happens here — the endpoint, the credentials and the report never leave this machine.Run a diagnosticMCP server endpoint The Streamable HTTP URL. Both the handshake revisions and 2026-07-28 are detected automatically.Credentials Auto-detectNoneBearer tokenOAuth client credentialsStored loginToken from environment variable Named, never typed. The browser sends the name; the token is read on this machine and never crosses the wire.SafetyRead-only tools are called by default. Everything below is an explicit opt-in. Also call tools that mutate but are not destructive Also call destructive and unannotated tools Skip the protocol-generation probe (one fewer request)Requests per second 0 removes the throttle. Only do that to a server you own.Per-call timeout (seconds) Run diagnostic Cancel ProgressEach phase reports as it finishes. Findings appear beneath the phase that produced them.ResultOpen the full report Download JSON The full report prints to PDF from your browser.

This page runs diagnostics in your browser and needs JavaScript. Without it, use the command line: scout check https://mcp.example.com/mcp
